license.basis: Publisher article Rights and permissions; author supplementary material attached to same article; no contrary credit/licensing text in workbook shared strings or supplementary description. Not an independent repository license. Preserve attribution and indicate format conversion.

import_status: Author processed matrices available for import as two distinct modalities; retain source feature IDs, sample roles and normalized log2 ratio scale. Not imported by this worker.
cohort_status: New quantitative source, not same matrix as existing CPTAC_HGSC. Evidence strongly indicates distinct retrospective TCGA vs prospective CPTAC cohorts; old exact upstream/fractionation identity unresolved, so no claim of crosswalk-proven donor disjointness.
normalization: Author normalized log2 sample/reference relative abundance; preserve negative/zero/positive source values, no new normalization or linearization.
missing_values: Literal NaN in source; may map to NA with explicit documented parser rule. Blank metadata preserved.

feature_mapping.Intact_Normalized: IGP-ID = gene_symbol + peptide + N/H/F/S/G glycan composition, split from right for glycan, preserve original ID. Gene symbols are not protein accessions. No absolute site inference.
feature_mapping.SPEG_normalized: SPEG-ID = gene symbol + chemically modified peptide; [144.102063] label and [0.984016] deamidation preserved. Deglycosylated site-containing peptides, NOT intact glycopeptides or total protein. No glycan composition supplied.

controls: 10 TCGA-OVARIAN-CONTROL-* columns per assay; retained with quality_control role, not 10 additional patients.
extraction: inspect_sources.py reads xlsx XML numeric lexemes without rounding or analytical transforms; exports all source rows/columns as TSV.gz.
unresolved: Old CPTAC_HGSC upstream MD5/fractionation identity remains unresolved and unchanged.
No cross-cohort donor alias mapping supplied; zero exact ID overlap does not itself prove no shared donors.
Supplementary Data 1 is aggregate clinical characteristics, not a sample-level covariate table.
scale: author-normalized log2 relative ratios; signed source values retained without inverse transformation
curated_status: Separate curated SEs provide 2^x linear relative ratios; original log2 source assets remain available
